sentences.text: The mountain path was far too quiet tonight, save for my faithful hound growling at shadows.
Suddenly a burning rock screamed across the dark sky, crashing into the ridge with a blinding green flash.
The old tales say such fallen stars awaken restless things that refuse to stay in their graves.
Down in the village square, kind old Nikos was always first to help mend a fence or share wine.
Yet strange muddy claw prints now led from his front door straight out toward the dark forest.
Through my half-closed window, I watched a shadowy silhouette shift its shape beneath the moonlight.
A sudden piercing shriek shattered the midnight air right outside my door.
Only a dropped lantern and a smear of dark blood remained upon the frosty path.
When a friendly neighbour vanishes without a trace, who is truly walking beside you in the dark?
